"""QA documental local: deriva casos existentes, no modifica producto."""
import argparse, copy, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys, uuid
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE = ROOT/'backend/postman'
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

def write(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')

def test(label, expression):
    return 'pm.test('+json.dumps(label)+',()=>{'+expression+'});'

def request(name, method, route, status=200, role='company', body=None, extra=()):
    headers=[{'key':'Accept','value':'application/json'}]
    if role: headers.append({'key':'Authorization','value':'Token {{'+role+'_token}}'})
    r={'method':method,'url':'{{base_url}}/'+route,'auth':{'type':'noauth'},'header':headers}
    if body is not None:
        headers.append({'key':'Content-Type','value':'application/json'})
        r['body']={'mode':'raw','raw':json.dumps(body,ensure_ascii=True),'options':{'raw':{'language':'json'}}}
    scripts=[test('HTTP '+str(status),'pm.response.to.have.status('+str(status)+');'),test('Respuesta JSON','pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an("object");'),*extra]
    return {'name':name,'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'request':r,'event':[{'listen':'test','script':{'type':'text/javascript','exec':scripts}}]}

def build(role, run):
    if role=='hu012':
        source=json.loads((HERE/'WorkNet.HU012.postman_collection.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        originals={int(re.match(r'PM(\d+)',x['name'])[1]):x for x in source['item'][1]['item']}
        items=[copy.deepcopy(source['item'][0]['item'][2])]
        for n in range(255,276):
            items.append(copy.deepcopy(originals[n]))
            if n in [259,260]:
                template={259:'moderna',260:'minimalista'}[n]
                x=copy.deepcopy(originals[268]);x['id']=str(uuid.uuid4());x['name']='DOC12 PDF guardado '+template
                items.append(x)
        items.append(request('DOC12 Descarga empresa rechazada','GET','curriculum/generated/pdf/',403))
    elif role=='hu013':
        source=json.loads((HERE/'WorkNet.HU013.postman_collection.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        items=copy.deepcopy([source['item'][i] for i in [1,2,8]])
        items[1]['event'][0]['script']['exec'].append(test('Empresa propietaria y estado publicados','const o=pm.response.json().offer;pm.expect(o.company_name).to.equal("Empresa aprobada QA");pm.expect(o.status).to.equal("published");pm.environment.set("published_offer_id",o.id);'))
    elif role=='hu014':
        data=dict(title='Oferta editada Desktop HU014',description='Descripción editada QA',requirements='Django y Flutter QA',salary='3200000.50',location='Pasto QA',category='Tecnología',contract_type='Fijo')
        items=[
          request('D14-01 Listado propio activo','GET','company/offers/active/',extra=[test('Solo dos ofertas propias activas','const j=pm.response.json();pm.expect(j.count).to.equal(2);pm.expect(j.offers).to.have.length(2);')]),
          request('D14-02 Precarga','GET','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',extra=[test('Siete campos y estado inicial','const o=pm.response.json().offer;pm.expect(o.status).to.equal("published");pm.expect(o.salary).to.equal("1000000.00");pm.environment.set("offer_initial",JSON.stringify(o));')]),
          request('D14-03 PATCH siete campos','PATCH','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',body=data,extra=[test('Edición y propietario conservados','const o=pm.response.json().offer;pm.expect(o.title).to.equal("Oferta editada Desktop HU014");pm.expect(o.salary).to.equal("3200000.50");const b=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("offer_initial"));for(const k of ["id","company_name","status","published_at","expires_at"])pm.expect(o[k]).to.deep.equal(b[k]);pm.environment.set("offer_edited",JSON.stringify(o));')]),
          request('D14-04 Reconsulta persistida','GET','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',extra=[test('Siete campos persistidos','pm.expect(pm.response.json().offer).to.deep.equal(JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("offer_edited")));')]),
          request('D14-05 Inválidos sin escritura','PATCH','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',400,body={'title':'NO DEBE GUARDARSE','salary':'-1'}),
          request('D14-06 Reconsulta tras inválidos','GET','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',extra=[test('Sin escritura parcial','pm.expect(pm.response.json().offer).to.deep.equal(JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("offer_edited")));')]),
          request('D14-07 Sin sesión','GET','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',401,role=None),
          request('D14-08 Candidato','GET','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',403,role='candidate'),
          request('D14-09 Empresa pendiente','GET','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',403,role='draft'),
          request('D14-10 Oferta ajena','GET','company/offers/{{other_offer_id}}/',404),
          request('D14-11 PATCH ajeno','PATCH','company/offers/{{other_offer_id}}/',404,body=data),
          request('D14-12 Archivada','GET','company/offers/{{archived_offer_id}}/',409),
          request('D14-13 Cerrada','PATCH','company/offers/{{closed_offer_id}}/',409,body=data),
          request('D14-14 Borrador','GET','company/offers/{{draft_offer_id}}/',409),
          request('D14-15 Vencida','GET','company/offers/{{expired_offer_id}}/',409),
        ]
    else:
        items=[
          request('D15-01 Activas iniciales','GET','company/offers/active/',extra=[test('Tres activas propias','pm.expect(pm.response.json().count).to.equal(3);')]),
          request('D15-02 Conservadas iniciales','GET','company/offers/preserved/',extra=[test('Dos conservadas iniciales','pm.expect(pm.response.json().count).to.equal(2);')]),
          request('D15-03 Archivado sin confirmar','POST','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/transition/',400,body={'action':'archive','confirm':False}),
          request('D15-04 Sin cambio tras inválido','GET','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/',extra=[test('Oferta sigue publicada','pm.expect(pm.response.json().offer.status).to.equal("published");pm.environment.set("lifecycle_initial",JSON.stringify(pm.response.json().offer));')]),
          request('D15-05 Cierre válido','POST','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/transition/',body={'action':'close'},extra=[test('Cerrada y datos intactos','const o=pm.response.json().offer,b=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("lifecycle_initial"));pm.expect(o.status).to.equal("closed");delete o.status;delete b.status;pm.expect(o).to.deep.equal(b);')]),
          request('D15-06 Archivado confirmado','POST','company/offers/{{second_offer_id}}/transition/',body={'action':'archive','confirm':True},extra=[test('Archivada','pm.expect(pm.response.json().offer.status).to.equal("archived");')]),
          request('D15-07 Activas tras transiciones','GET','company/offers/active/',extra=[test('Cerrada y archivada excluidas','const j=pm.response.json();pm.expect(j.count).to.equal(1);for(const o of j.offers)pm.expect([Number(pm.environment.get("offer_id")),Number(pm.environment.get("second_offer_id"))]).not.to.include(o.id);')]),
          request('D15-08 Historial conservado','GET','company/offers/preserved/',extra=[test('Cuatro conservadas y estados persistidos','const j=pm.response.json();pm.expect(j.count).to.equal(4);pm.expect(j.offers.find(o=>o.id===Number(pm.environment.get("offer_id"))).status).to.equal("closed");pm.expect(j.offers.find(o=>o.id===Number(pm.environment.get("second_offer_id"))).status).to.equal("archived");')]),
          request('D15-09 Transición incompatible','POST','company/offers/{{archived_offer_id}}/transition/',409,body={'action':'close'}),
          request('D15-10 Oferta ajena','POST','company/offers/{{other_offer_id}}/transition/',404,body={'action':'close'}),
          request('D15-11 Sin sesión','POST','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/transition/',401,role=None,body={'action':'close'}),
          request('D15-12 Candidato','POST','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/transition/',403,role='candidate',body={'action':'close'}),
          request('D15-13 Empresa pendiente','POST','company/offers/{{offer_id}}/transition/',403,role='draft',body={'action':'close'}),
          request('D15-14 Reintento idempotente','POST','company/offers/{{second_offer_id}}/transition/',body={'action':'archive','confirm':True},extra=[test('Continúa archivada','pm.expect(pm.response.json().offer.status).to.equal("archived");')]),
          request('D15-15 Relaciones del dashboard','GET','dashboard/company/',extra=[test('Dos postulaciones originales conservadas','const j=pm.response.json();pm.expect(j.metrics.applications).to.equal(2);pm.expect(j.recent_applications).to.have.length(2);')]),
        ]
    port=json.loads((run/'state.json').read_text())['port']
    guard=f'if(pm.environment.get("base_url")!=="http://127.0.0.1:{port}/api" || pm.environment.get("qa_run_id")!=="{run.name}" || pm.environment.get("qa_confirmation")!=="SOLO_BASE_AISLADA")throw new Error("QA exclusiva requerida");'
    return {'info':{'name':'WorkNet DOC '+role.upper()+' 08-11-2026','_postman_id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'schema':'https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json'},'item':items,'event':[{'listen':'prerequest','script':{'type':'text/javascript','exec':[guard]}}]}

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('role',choices=['hu012','hu013','hu014','hu015']);p.add_argument('port',type=int);a=p.parse_args()
    prior=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(HERE/'qa.py'),'prepare','--port',str(a.port)],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if prior.returncode: raise RuntimeError('qa.py prepare no completó: '+prior.stderr[-500:])
    name=re.search(r'run-\d+T\d+-[a-f0-9]+',prior.stdout)[0]
    import qa
    run,state=qa.load_run(name)
    if a.role in ['hu014','hu015']:
        sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'frontend/tool/browser_qa'))
        fixtures=__import__(a.role+'_fixtures');fixtures.execute(run,run,{'suite':a.role},a.role+'_prepare')
    qa.configure(run,state)
    from accounts.models import User
    from rest_framework.authtoken.models import Token
    from candidate_dashboard.models import JobOffer
    env=json.loads((run/'local.postman_environment.json').read_text())
    values={v['key']:v for v in env['values']}
    def put(k,v,secret=False):
        values[k]={'key':k,'value':v,'enabled':True,'type':'secret' if secret else 'default'}
    for role in ['candidate','other','company','draft']:
        u=User.objects.get(email=values[role+'_email']['value'])
        assert u.check_password(values['qa_password']['value'])
        token,_=Token.objects.get_or_create(user=u)
        put(role+'_token',token.key,True);put(role+'_id',u.pk)
    offers=list(JobOffer.objects.order_by('id'))
    for k,o in zip(['offer_id','second_offer_id','other_offer_id','archived_offer_id','closed_offer_id','draft_offer_id','expired_offer_id'],offers):put(k,o.pk)
    env['values']=list(values.values());write(run/'local.postman_environment.json',env)
    collection=build(a.role,run);write(run/'desktop.postman_collection.json',collection)
    manifest={'suite':a.role,'run':name,'port':a.port,'sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),'requests':len(collection['item']),'collection_sha256':hashlib.sha256((run/'desktop.postman_collection.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    write(OUT/(a.role+'.json'),manifest)
    print(json.dumps(manifest));print('IMPORT: '+str(run/'desktop.postman_collection.json'));print('ENV: '+str(run/'local.postman_environment.json'))

Servir únicamente el run devuelto con python backend/postman/qa.py serve --run RUN_NUEVO.
